signatureHandling.note: Action pose establishes reusable key silhouette only; full timing/sequence treatment remains for the dedicated signature-sequences phase.

notes: Dallas official current roster and depth chart were rechecked immediately before production.
Official current sources confirm Steele #78 T, Brown #80 WR, Schoonmaker #86 TE, Ferguson #87 TE and Lamb #88 WR.
Ferguson is the current starting TE and a 2026 Pro Bowl selection; no named signature celebration is asserted without a verified source.
Lamb's already-recognized historical nose-wipe first-down concept is preserved as a reusable key pose; detailed signature animation remains reserved for signature-sequences.
Official current player pages/headshots remain the sole authority for visible appearance and skin tone; no appearance trait is inferred from a name.

requirements: Every pose action must exist in the player's roster.json action inventory.
Locked face, skin tone, hair/facial hair, jersey number, scale and foot anchor may not drift between actions.
Catch and carry poses must preserve football continuity and hand-to-ball contact.
Blocking/contact poses must avoid impossible limb intersections and preserve believable leverage.
Transparent alpha edges must remain clean at Gamecast scale.
Named signature concepts require verified source authority and must not be generalized to other players.
